item.title: Texas Tenant Rights in 2026: The Complete Guide
item.description:
Texas Tenant Rights in 2026: The Complete Guide

Quick Answer

Texas has no cap on security deposits — but landlords must return yours within 30 days of move-out with an itemized list, or owe triple the withheld amount plus $100 (Property Code §92.109). Late fees are capped at 12% of monthly rent (10% in buildings with more than 4 units) and can’t be charged until rent is 2 full days late (§92.019). There’s no statutory entry-notice rule, no rent control — it’s banned statewide — and evictions move fast: 3-day notice to vacate, then a swift court process.
